meta.title: Keel Updates — Synthetic verification fixtures
meta.author: dknauss
meta.description: Unreleased branch preview. All evidence is synthetic; real downloads and installs are blocked. Toggle recent/stale attempted checks, inspect partial schedule Unknown and plugin/theme decisions changed by code.

Theme Name: Synthetic fixture theme — no real updates

Demo: synthetic update data. No live checks or scheduled installs are demonstrated. Downloads and installations are blocked.

Attempt: 2 days ago · Attempt: 5 minutes ago

About this demo

Open Update diagnostics to inspect partial schedule coverage (Unknown) and fixture plugin/theme decisions changed by code. Other items have no fixture metadata. The disabled updater is a demo safeguard, not evidence about your site.

'; } ); add_filter( 'pre_site_transient_update_core', function () { global $wp_version; return (object) array( 'last_checked' => time() - keel_demo_attempt_age(), 'version_checked' => $wp_version, 'updates' => array() ); } ); add_filter( 'pre_transient_keel_cron_report', function () { return array( 'schema' => 1, 'site' => get_current_blog_id(), 'checked' => time() - 120, 'error' => '', 'done' => true, 'data' => array( 'examined' => 2000, 'limited' => true, 'malformed' => false, 'core' => array(), 'overdue' => array(), 'frequent' => array() ), 'update' => array( 'offer_age' => keel_demo_attempt_age(), 'failure' => null ), ); } ); // Only these installed demo items get metadata; never synthesize a download URL. add_filter( 'pre_site_transient_update_plugins', function () { return (object) array( 'last_checked' => time(), 'response' => array(), 'no_update' => array( 'synthetic-keel-demo/synthetic-keel-demo.php' => (object) array( 'plugin' => 'synthetic-keel-demo/synthetic-keel-demo.php', 'autoupdate' => false ), ) ); } ); add_filter( 'pre_site_transient_update_themes', function () { return (object) array( 'last_checked' => time(), 'response' => array(), 'no_update' => array( 'synthetic-keel-demo' => array( 'theme' => 'synthetic-keel-demo', 'autoupdate' => true ), ) ); } ); add_filter( 'auto_update_plugin', function ( $decision, $item ) { return isset( $item->plugin ) && 'synthetic-keel-demo/synthetic-keel-demo.php' === $item->plugin ? true : $decision; }, PHP_INT_MAX, 2 ); add_filter( 'auto_update_theme', function ( $decision, $item ) { return isset( $item->theme ) && 'synthetic-keel-demo' === $item->theme ? false : $decision; }, PHP_INT_MAX, 2 ); // Keep read capabilities so Keel renders; reject updater execution instead. add_filter( 'automatic_updater_disabled', '__return_true', PHP_INT_MAX ); add_filter( 'pre_http_request', function () { return new WP_Error( 'synthetic_demo_network_blocked', 'SYNTHETIC demo: outbound WordPress HTTP is disabled.' ); }, PHP_INT_MAX ); function keel_demo_block_install() { return new WP_Error( 'synthetic_demo_install_blocked', 'SYNTHETIC demo: real downloads and installations are disabled.' ); } add_filter( 'upgrader_pre_download', 'keel_demo_block_install', PHP_INT_MAX ); add_filter( 'upgrader_pre_install', 'keel_demo_block_install', PHP_INT_MAX );
